title: Regression: Tunnel pipe mode being used on IPinIP on Broadcom systems
author: arista-nwolfe
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Previous Working Version

Prior to https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/21868 merging

### Steps to Reproduce

Startup any Broadcom device and we see it crashing with:
```
NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- addDecapTunnel: Create overlay loopback router interface oid:6000000000ce1
ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_TUNNEL:brcm_sai_create_tunnel:1537 Unknown/unsupported tunnel attribute 27 passed
ERR syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_TUNNEL:brcm_sai_create_tunnel:1542 Error processing tunnel attribute failed with error -196614.
ERR syncd#syncd: :- sendApiResponse: api SAI_COMMON_API_CREATE failed in syncd mode: SAI_STATUS_ATTR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED_6
ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_TYPE: SAI_TUNNEL_TYPE_IPINIP
ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_OVERLAY_INTERFACE: oid:0x6000000000ce1
ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_UNDERLAY_INTERFACE: oid:0x6000000000c85
ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_ECN_MODE: SAI_TUNNEL_DECAP_ECN_MODE_COPY_FROM_OUTER
ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_TTL_MODE: SAI_TUNNEL_TTL_MODE_PIPE_MODEL
ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_DSCP_MODE: SAI_TUNNEL_DSCP_MODE_PIPE_MODEL
ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_QOS_DSCP_TO_TC_MAP: oid:0x14000000000cda
ERR swss#orchagent: :- create: create status: SAI_STATUS_ATTR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED_6
ERR swss#orchagent: :- addDecapTunnel: Failed to create tunnel
ERR swss#orchagent: :- handleSaiCreateStatus: Encountered failure in create operation, exiting orchagent, SAI API: SAI_API_TUNNEL, status: SAI_STATUS_ATTR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED_6
NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- notifySyncd: sending syncd: SYNCD_INVOKE_DUMP
NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- processNotifySyncd: Invoking SAI failure dump
NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- sai_redis_notify_syncd: invoked DUMP succeeded
```

This appears to be because the condition added by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/21868 to skip using Tunnel pipe mode on broadcom devices isn't working:
```
        "TUNNEL_DECAP_TABLE:IPINIP_TUNNEL" : {
            "tunnel_type":"IPINIP",
{% if "broadcom" in asic_type %}
            "dscp_mode":"uniform",
{% else %}
            "dscp_mode":"pipe",
            "decap_dscp_to_tc_map":"AZURE",
{% endif %}
```

But I see the generated file is using pipe:
```
# sonic-db-cli APPL_DB hgetall "TUNNEL_DECAP_TABLE:IPINIP_TUNNEL"
{'decap_dscp_to_tc_map': 'AZURE', 'dscp_mode': 'pipe', 'ecn_mode': 'copy_from_outer', 'ttl_mode': 'pipe', 'tunnel_type': 'IPINIP'}
```

I had trouble tracing the rendering of this tempalte but I believe likely the issue is that `asic_type` is not defined before rendering the template so `{% if "broadcom" in asic_type %}` will never return true.

### Impact of this regression

Broadcom devices have Orchagent crashing on `master`

comments.author: arista-nwolfe
comments.body:
It looks like `ipinip.json.j2` is rendered using `-y /etc/sonic/constants.yml` here:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/3d3e3a800a14173c4b6bdf9f5a73d772748327fb/dockers/docker-orchagent/docker-init.j2#L17

I can see there is no reference to `asic_type` in `/etc/sonic/constants.yml`:
```
> grep "asic_type" /etc/sonic/constants.yml

```

Which is why we won't render the template correctly:
```
> sonic-cfggen -d -y /etc/sonic/constants.yml -t ipinip.json.j2 | grep "dscp_mode"
            "dscp_mode":"pipe",
            "dscp_mode":"pipe",
```

If I change the source file to one that does include `asic_type` like `/etc/sonic/sonic_version.yml` I see it render as expected (no pipe mode):
```
> grep "asic_type" /etc/sonic/sonic_version.yml
asic_type: broadcom

> sonic-cfggen -d -y /etc/sonic/sonic_version.yml -t ipinip.json.j2 | grep "dscp_mode"
            "dscp_mode":"uniform",
            "dscp_mode":"uniform",
```
